leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Zero Point Cryogenics is an Edmonton manufacturer of customizable dilution refrigerators and cryogenic equipment for quantum and low-temperature research. Zero Point Cryogenics designs customizable dilution refrigerators, continuous-cold systems and related cryogenic equipment, including platforms with optical, RF and DC wiring support. PrairiesCan announced a $5 million RDII investment for Zero Point Cryogenics to commercialize sub-kelvin cryogenics for defence prototypes and mission-critical quantum sensing, computing and communications systems.

leads.candidateCapabilityName: Advanced aerospace and defence composite structures
leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Stelia North America is an Airbus Atlantic company designing, developing and manufacturing advanced composite structures for aerospace, defence and space programs from Lunenburg, Nova Scotia and Mirabel, Quebec. Stelia North America designs and manufactures advanced composite structures using automated fibre placement, filament winding, hand lay-up, resin-transfer processes, tooling, assembly and non-destructive inspection. ACOA announced more than $600,000 in RDII support for Stelia to install advanced manufacturing and inspection equipment, including CNC machines, a robotic sanding cell, a process oven, measuring equipment and a 3D printer.

leads.candidateCapabilityName: Mission intelligence and edge decision-support systems
leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Atreides is a Victoria, British Columbia intelligence-software company that converts multi-domain, fragmented data into structured mission-ready insight for high-consequence decisions. Atreides provides a behavioural-intelligence suite for structured insight from fragmented data and deployable mission systems that combine secure communications, edge processing and interfaces for field intelligence operations. PacifiCan announced a $2,486,128 RDII investment for Atreides to commercialize an AI-powered platform improving how unmanned systems collect, share and analyze land, air and maritime data.
